sqlite_path.description: Path to SQLite database file (leave empty to use MySQL instead). Set to non-empty to switch Akonadi to SQLite mode.

mysql_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the MySQL server (ignored if SQLite is used).

mysql_port.description: TCP port of the MySQL server (ignored if SQLite is used).

mysql_database.description: Name of the MySQL database to use for Akonadi.

mysql_user.description: MySQL user for Akonadi. Must have CREATE, SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, INDEX permissions.

mysql_password.description: Password for the MySQL user. Leave blank for no password (not recommended for production).

mysql_exec_path.description: Directory containing MySQL client binaries (mysql, mysqldump, etc.). Used for auto-setup and repair.

debug_enabled.description: Enable verbose debug output to aid troubleshooting.

sql_logging.description: Log all SQL queries to a file for debugging.

data_home.description: Base directory for Akonadi data (e.g., resource config). Supports ~ expansion.

config_home.description: Base directory for Akonadi configuration files.

cache_home.description: Base directory for Akonadi cache files (e.g., index, search DB).

runtime_dir.description: Directory for runtime files: PID, sockets, locks.

connection_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a database connection before failing.

max_reconnection_attempts.description: Maximum number of reconnection attempts if database connection is lost.

enable_migration.description: Allow Akonadi to automatically migrate the database schema on startup if needed.

indexing_enabled.description: Enable semantic indexing of PIM items (e.g., for fast search).

batch_size.description: Maximum number of items to index per batch.

max_memory_indexing.description: Maximum memory (MB) the indexer may use. Reduce on low-memory systems.

polling_interval.description: Interval (ms) between polling for pending indexing tasks.

search_backend.description: Search backend to use. Options: Baloo (recommended), Internal.

resource_agents.description: List of resource agents to configure (e.g., IMAP, Maildir). Each agent controls a mail or contact store.

name.description: Human-readable name of the agent (e.g., 'Personal Mailbox'). Used in UI.

type.description: Agent type (e.g., 'imap', 'maildir', 'mbox', 'kabc', 'kcal'). Must match a registered resource plugin.

enabled.description: Whether the agent is active and will be started on Akonadi startup.

executable_path.description: Override path to agent executable (leave blank to use default location).

fs_monitoring_enabled.description: Enable filesystem monitoring (via inotify or polling) to detect external changes to PIM folders.

fs_polling_interval.description: Fallback polling interval (ms) when inotify monitoring is unavailable (e.g., over NFS).

mysql_tuning.description: Enable embedded MySQL tuning parameters (use only when embedding mysqld in Akonadi).

mysql_server_binary.description: Path to embedded MySQL server binary (used only if mysql_tuning is enabled).

mysql_innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: InnoDB buffer pool size (MB). Larger = better performance, but more RAM.

mysql_innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit.description: InnoDB fsync behavior: 1=most safe, 2=fast (crash-safe on most OS), 0=fastest (less safe).

mysql_innodb_purge_threads.description: Number of background threads for InnoDB row purging.

mysql_innodb_read_io_threads.description: Number of I/O threads for read operations.

mysql_innodb_write_io_threads.description: Number of I/O threads for write operations.

mysql_innodb_thread_concurrency.description: Max concurrent InnoDB threads (0 = unlimited, recommended for modern kernels).
